buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Incharge Sports Authority of India Training Centre Mastuana Sahib payable at Sangrur . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date.

4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Incharge Sports Authority of India Training Centre Mastuana Sahib payable at Sangrur . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 6. Seeking any deposits or security amounts from the deployed resources or any other form of monetary a cceptance by the Service Provider is strictly prohibited. If any such complaint is received, an incident will b e raised on GeM portal for suitable action as per the Incident Management Policy of GeM. In addition, buye r department may separately initiate suitable penal action as per laid down norms. 2. Bidder Financial Standing: The Bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or simil ar proceedings and should not be bankrupt. Bidder must upload undertaking in this effect along wi th his bid, which should not more than one month old from the date of publication of Tender. 3. Project Experience Required: The Bidder must have executed at least one Single-order of 80% v alue of the Bid or Two-orders each of 50% value of the Bid or Three-orders each of 40% value of th e Bid for similar services in the last three years to any Central/ State Govt. Organization/ PSUs/ or any Public Listed Company. 4. Average Turnover in last three financial consecutive Years (i.e., F.Y. 2023-24 & 2024-25 & 2025-26) duly certified by the Chartered Accountant is required to be submitted alongwith the bid. 5. Startup Exemption for Years of Experience and Turnover –YES 6. MSE Exemption for Years of Experience and Turnover –YES 7. EMD percentage - 2% and EPBG Percentage - 3% of the total Contract Value. Validity (90days b eyond the date of termination of the contract). 8. Bidders can submit the EMD in the form of Account Payee DD in the name of Incharge Sports Au thority of India Training Centre Mastuana Sahib. The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledge. The earnest money shall be r

efunded to the unsuccessful Bidders after finalization of the contract. For release of EMD to the su ccessful Bidder on receipt of Performance Security deposit, the FDR will be released, in favour of I ncharge Sports Authority of India Training Centre Mastuana Sahib. Bidder by the Buyer after maki ng endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. No in terest is payable on the EMD. 9. The number of personnel required to be supplied by the contractor shall be at the sole discretion of Assistant Director STC Mastuana Sahib. (Expired Labour License of the Contractor and recently expired License in the financial year, FY 2024-25 will not be considered). 10. Bidder must attached copy of GST, PAN and TAN certificates. 11. A Check-list of all the documents attached by the Bidder with their page numbers must be upl oaded along with the bid. 12. The successful Bidder shall pay wages to all the Outsourced Employees on or before the 7th of every month and this payment shall be released to the concerned Service Provider as and when th eir bills are passed by the department. 13. Wages shall be paid as per given norms as per the tender documents like EPF, ESI, EDLI etc. T he ESI and PF shall be deposited by the Contractor well in time and documents submitted to Office. All rules regarding implementation of EPF/ ESI must be followed as per the guideline of GFR and th e instructions issued by the Central Govt. regarding EPF/ ESI from time to time. 14. The Contactor shall be liable for meeting all the statutory requirements as provided by the Act s governing Labour Laws, i.e., Minimum Wages Act, PF, ESI, Holidays, etc. The rates so allowed to and paid to the Contractor shall include all such statutory liabilities. 15: (a) The buyer reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50% at the time of placement of contract. The buyer also reserves the right to increase the order quantity by up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the contract at the contracted rates. Bidd ers are bound to accept the orders accordingly. (b) The initial contract shall be for 1 (One) year. However, the buyer reserves its right to extend th e contract up to two years beyond the initial contract duration subject to the satisfactory performa nce of the Bidder/ Service Provider and with mutual consent on yearly basis subject to a maximum of 3 (three) years. 16. Sub-letting of the Contract by the seller is not allowed. 17. The TDS as applicable shall be deducted by the buyer from the bills raised by the contractor an d deposited by the buyer accordingly. 18. Bidder(s) must provide a dedicated Landline/ Mobile No. for service support.

19. For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria. a. Purchase order copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that supplies ag ainst the Invoices have been executed. b. Execution certificate by the client with order value. c. Any other documents in support of order execution like 3rd Party inspection release notes, etc . 20. The Technical committee will examine the Bids and approve the participating Firms for their el igibility to qualifying technically according to the T&C of published Tender. 21. Salary Slip to be provided to the employees, whenever employees required. 22. Identity card/Uniform dress to be provided to the employees. 23. PSARA Experience Certificate under the Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act, 2005 for S ecurity Manpower Service (Version 2.0) is to be required. Reliever to be provided in the absence of Securit y Guard/weekly off. . 8. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 9. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 10. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.
